proof_body:
by
  intro n _
  have e : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (1 : ℝ) / ((k : ℝ) + 1) = ((harmonic n : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
    simp [harmonic]
  rw [e]
  have h1 := log_add_one_le_harmonic n
  have h2 := harmonic_le_one_add_log n
  push_cast at h1
  exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
target_source: ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → Real.log ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (1 : ℝ) / ((k : ℝ) + 1) ∧ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (1 : ℝ) / ((k : ℝ) + 1) ≤ 1 + Real.log n
